fixtures: Five solvable three-file scenarios based on the earlier corpus, with relational contracts, plus one deliberate equivalence control. Shipping has a third parameter and requires a coordinated probe. Cycle offset has one public check outside its legal domain to distinguish the two gates. The equivalence control omits that check. Use the same contracts, public checks, fixed pools and 72 new valid held-out checks in both languages.
search: Independently derive i64 intervals using the same parameter comparisons and order of relaxation. Keep the same edit and probe budgets as experiment 64. Skip fixed inputs violating the relational contract. After the fixed pool, generate the previous ordered seeds, satisfying cross-parameter constraints by raising or lowering linked coordinates, with upward projection first. Search the first normal differing output and use the separate TIDE oracle for its expected value.
resolution: At most three confirmed tests, with the same repeated filtering and joint preview of a sole pair. Apply to a fresh scratch project and reopen for public and held-out acceptance. Count ambiguity and every other unresolved attempt as a failed repair. Measure time to abstention separately.
timer: Same monotonic interval as 64, including fixed-pool preparation, contract resolution inside the commands, every search and confirmation, application and acceptance or abstention. Fixture preparation is outside the timer.
repetitions: Twelve timed pairs per scenario after qualification. Rotate scenarios and alternate first language. Fresh processes, fresh project copies and one logical CPU with warm filesystem caches, all local, without network or model calls.
